items.text: On Linux, viewer panes get the navigation bar and the browser keys.
On Linux, a document pane updates itself when its file is saved, answers +reload, and recovers when its web process dies.
On Linux, a document, code or website pane can be searched with Ctrl+F.
On Linux, links in a document or web pane go where they do on Mac and Windows, and right-clicking one gives Ghoztty's link menu.
After an update, the leftover installer copy is cleaned up in the background instead of lingering until the next launch.
Fork CI's Windows cross-compile no longer inherits a broken build cache from a cancelled run.
Fork CI lets a running check finish instead of cancelling it on every push.
